requirement_text.REQ-419:
Build-order M1 (docs/mobile/build-order.md): MOB-1 in docs/mobile/requirements.md, placement and stack per docs/mobile/architecture.md §2, stack settled by docs/migration/decisions/0012-mobile-tier-stack.md (not re-decided here). This requirement creates apps/mobile/; nothing in it authenticates or fetches (that is REQ-421).

BUILDS:
1. `flutter create --org com.bizdala --project-name letflow --platforms android,ios apps/mobile` (Android applicationId and iOS bundle id com.bizdala.letflow -- must match REQ-418's redirect scheme). Android minSdk 26 in android/app/build.gradle(.kts); iOS deployment target 15.0 in ios/Podfile and the Xcode project.
2. pubspec.yaml: environment pins `sdk` to the Dart 3.11 line and a `flutter: 3.41.7` constraint (REQ-420's CI reads the Flutter version from this file); dependencies go_router, flutter_riverpod, dio, flutter_appauth, flutter_secure_storage, intl -- nothing else at runtime yet (the local cache store is REQ-423's choice).
3. lib/ layout exactly per architecture.md §2 (bootstrap/, auth/, api/, definitions/, renderers/{form,list,process,task}/, features/, design_system/, i18n/, shared/), a ProviderScope root, and a go_router with a placeholder slug-entry route. A renderer registry in lib/renderers/ keyed by definition type that returns an explicit "unsupported definition type" widget for an unknown type -- never a blank screen (MOB-4's stale-version principle, applied from day one).
4. analysis_options.yaml including flutter_lints (or stricter).
5. THREE STATIC GUARDS as ordinary Dart tests under apps/mobile/test/guards/ (so they run in `flutter test` and fail CI, not warn; architecture.md §6 requires the boundary rule to fail the build):
(a) module boundary, 0039 D3 as restated in architecture.md §6: no file outside lib/features/<id>/ imports from it except the one sanctioned navigation-bootstrap file, and lib/features/a/ imports from lib/features/b/ only if b is in a's declared depends_on (store the declaration in a single Dart/JSON manifest the guard reads);
(b) forbidden dependencies: pubspec.yaml and pubspec.lock contain no script runtime (e.g. flutter_js, any lua or wasm runtime package), no CEL package (REQ-294 forbids one), and no webview package (webview_flutter, flutter_inappwebview -- MOB-2 forbids embedded webview OIDC);
(c) no tenant identifier compiled in: no string literal in lib/ equals a tenant slug or realm name that exists in priv/keycloak/realms/*.json or test/support fixtures (at minimum 'bpm-default'), and no asset under apps/mobile/assets/ is tenant-specific.
Each guard must include a self-test proving it fires (e.g. runs its checker over an in-test fixture string that violates it).
6. apps/mobile/README.md: how to run (`flutter pub get`, `flutter analyze`, `flutter test`, `flutter run -d emulator-5554`), the platform API base URL supplied at build time via --dart-define=LETFLOW_API_BASE_URL (a platform endpoint per environment, not a tenant identifier), and how to reach a local backend from the emulator: `adb reverse tcp:<api-port> tcp:<api-port>` and `adb reverse tcp:<keycloak-port> tcp:<keycloak-port>` so the device reaches both at localhost. State why 10.0.2.2 is not enough: it reaches the API, but Keycloak stamps a token's iss from the host the browser used, so a login through 10.0.2.2 yields an iss the backend's configured issuer (localhost) rejects. Update docs/mobile/README.md's "Nothing is built" line to state the scaffold exists as of this requirement.

iOS: files are generated and configured; building them is DEFERRED -- the build host is Windows and cannot run Xcode. Recorded, not dropped.

task.description: Implement REQ-419 exactly per lib/letflow/design/req419-mobile-scaffold.md (CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR PASSed it in Step 1b -- read it directly, it is the authoritative build spec, not a summary of it). Branch feature/WF02-REQ419-20260927 is already checked out with the design commit on it -- verify with `git branch --show-current` before touching anything. Build apps/mobile/ via `flutter create` and hand-author everything else per the design doc's file-by-file spec: pubspec.yaml dependencies, the lib/ tree (bootstrap/, auth/, api/, definitions/, renderers/{form,list,process,task}/, features/, design_system/, i18n/, shared/, main.dart, and the one sanctioned app/router file), the renderer registry with its explicit unsupported-definition-type fallback widget, analysis_options.yaml, the three static guards under apps/mobile/test/guards/ (module boundary, forbidden dependencies, no compiled-in tenant identifier) each with a self-test that demonstrates it fires on a violating fixture, apps/mobile/README.md, the docs/mobile/README.md 'Nothing is built' line update, and ios/Podfile's `platform :ios, '15.0'` line. Run `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` from apps/mobile/ and fix until both pass, quoting real output. Also run `flutter build apk --debug` and quote its real output plus the two grep checks (minSdk, applicationId) from the acceptance criteria. Confirm the tracked-file directory listing (git ls-files apps/mobile/lib | cut -d/ -f4 | sort -u) matches exactly. State plainly in your result that the iOS build itself was not run (Windows host, no Xcode) while the Podfile/Xcode config was still generated and verified. Do not touch web/ or lib/letflow/ -- if you find a genuine backend gap, report it to ORCH rather than working around it. When done: git add every new/changed file under apps/mobile/ and docs/mobile/README.md plus this handoff, commit (do NOT push -- ORCH pushes), fill result with PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL and real command output, set next_action to 'Route to REVIEWER (Step 2d) -- SECURITY-REVIEWER not required, this requirement does not touch auth/token storage/transport' (per WF-02 Step 2b-mobile's own routing note), and set top-level status to COMPLETED.
acceptance_criteria: `cd apps/mobile && flutter analyze` reports 'No issues found!', real output quoted
`cd apps/mobile && flutter test` passes and its output lists the three guard test files and their self-tests, real output quoted

`cd apps/mobile && flutter build apk --debug` succeeds, and `grep -rn 'minSdk' android/app/build.gradle*` shows 26 and `grep -rn 'applicationId' android/app/build.gradle*` shows com.bizdala.letflow, both quoted

each guard's self-test demonstrates it FAILS on a violating fixture: the boundary guard on a cross-feature import not in depends_on, the dependency guard on a pubspec containing webview_flutter, the tenant-identifier guard on a literal 'bpm-default' -- asserted in the test, quoted in the report

`git ls-files apps/mobile/lib | cut -d/ -f4 | sort -u` (tracked files only) shows exactly the top-level directories named in docs/mobile/architecture.md §2 (bootstrap, auth, api, definitions, renderers, features, design_system, i18n, shared) plus main.dart and at most one app/router .dart file, quoted
a widget test asserts the renderer registry renders an explicit unsupported-definition-type widget (found by key or text) for an unknown definition type rather than an empty container
ios/Podfile declares platform :ios, '15.0' (quoted); the report states the iOS build is deferred because the host is Windows
`git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD` lists only paths under apps/mobile/ and docs/mobile/README.md
